no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Altamira has wound down its inner-ear clinical programs (Keyzilen/AM-101, Sonsuvi/AM-111, AM-125 betahistine — all completed or terminated) and is now focused on (i) commercializing Bentrio as an OTC nasal spray and (ii) preclinical out-licensing of its xPhore peptide-based nucleic-acid delivery platform (OligoPhore / SemaPhore). No active company-sponsored Phase 1/2/3 trials at snapshot date.
